title: Pepsi Offered A Fighter Jet. A Man Tried To Claim It ✈️
caption:
True story. A 1996 Pepsi ad offered a Harrier jet for 7 million points. One man tried to claim it. ✈️
Would you have tried it? 👇
first_comment: Pepsi then changed the ad to 700 MILLION points with a "just kidding". Who wins this one? ✈️👇
